system.description:
This spear is not much to look at. Made of dark, heavy wood, it is very old and covered in countless marks of combat. The spear’s head, a slab of dark metal, is set into a bone lattice work. Wrapped about the handle is a tatty scrap of black and red striped fur of some long-forgotten creature. Damage Rating: S Critical Rating: 2 Group: Spear Qualities: Fast, Magic, Pierce 2 Encumbrance: 4 Attacks made with Crimson Rain gain +1[Dc] to their dice pool, and:

M Recover 1 fatigue Suffer 1 corruption or 2 stress
